title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 079
review_goal: Differentiate qrcode, question, and radar variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Stylized QR code block with one tall left finder box and one smaller lower right finder box
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more stylized or simplified QR code pattern with larger open gaps.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the classic QR code when all three standard corner finder boxes should be clear and balanced.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot simplifies the code pattern and leaves more open space than the classic three corner QR layout.

items.depicts_observation: Question mark centered inside one circular ring with one small dot below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a help or question cue enclosed by a circular border.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain question mark when the mark should stand alone with no outer ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the question mark inside a full circular outline.

items.depicts_observation: Standalone question mark with one small dot below and no surrounding ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bare question mark cue without any outer border.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the circled help icon when the question mark should sit inside a full round frame.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the outer ring and leaves only the question mark and dot.

items.depicts_observation: Round radar target made from concentric arcs with one diagonal sweep line crossing the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic circular radar target with ring marks and a sweep line.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the angled radar dish when the shape should lean in one direction instead of staying round.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the radar shape circular with repeated rings around the middle.

items.depicts_observation: Angled radar dish with signal arcs fanning toward the upper right from one slanted base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a directional radar dish or scanner that points outward in one angled direction.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round radar target when the icon should stay centered with concentric rings.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the radar into a slanted dish shape with directional arcs instead of a circular target.
